summary: St. Louis County, MN U.S. Forest Service lookout on Pike Mountain northeast of Virginia; a 1936 station description places it there and it had been removed by 1973.

facts.status_note: Torn down; a county compilation says it had been removed by 1973. No source read describes the hilltop today.

events.note: Forest Service 1936 station description and survey notes place the station under the Pike Mt. lookout tower
Tower torn down; the county compilation says it had been removed by 1973
